title: Adding a collection and its items
_note: BCP admin recipe add-collection. Cut from ski-demo_add-collection_dev_09-20-00_v4.mp4 (389.94s) — TWO flows in one browser: create the collection and set its options, then add two items to it. FORTY-FOUR screens, not the 34 the old script assumed. Carson chose to narrate all of them rather than collapse the repeated second item. Twelve of the 44 are the `↰ back x6` walk, which goes BACKWARDS through pages already visited, so they get one short line each and the narration says plainly that we are retracing our steps. Screen edges in bounds_v4.json, taken from the flow logs and checked frame by frame.
